verdict.rationale: GitCafe ships an official `cafe` CLI. Its docs say it signs you in, sets up Git credentials, and manages repositories, pull requests, stacks, issues and more from the terminal, and `cafe api` reaches any REST endpoint. It also has agent-friendly flags: `--json` structured output, `--no-input` to fail instead of prompting, and `--yes` for non-interactive confirmation, with agent skills offered on top. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented (the probe only confirms the docs page exists).
